name: Claytonia (Miner's lettuce)

schedule.notes: Cool-weather lover; best as a fall/winter crop. Refrigerate seed for 2 weeks first to break dormancy.
Cut whole rosettes or snip individual leaves with their distinctive perfoliate stem-disks.

harvest.cues: Heart-shaped lower leaves and perfoliate stem leaves; small white flowers in spring.
harvest.storageNotes: Fridge in damp paper 3 to 5 days. Best fresh — succulent, mild spinach flavor.

varieties.name: Common Claytonia
varieties.notes: Native to the Pacific Northwest. One of the few salad greens that thrives in shade.

notes: Self-seeds prolifically — let one patch flower and you'll have winter salads forever. Tolerates more shade than almost any salad green. Mild, succulent, slightly mineral flavor.
